Case reference: 2023030253.CaseDesc: Autumn Shaganash was last seen on June 10, 2023.  She has had no activity on her bank account, no money on her person, and no cellphone. Autumn, according to her immediate family, suffers from depression and anxiety and must take prescribed medication on a daily basis. She hasn't taken her medication since.

Case reference: 2014004744.CaseDesc: Cyril Detimmerman and a friend left Brandon, Manitoba, on April 10, 1976 on the Assiniboine River to travel to Treherne. Cyril was experienced in navigating the river, but the water levels were very high due to spring flooding. The pair soon encountered strong currents and large amounts of debris in the river. While attempting to navigate to shore, the boat capsized, sending both men into the water. Both men were wearing life jackets. Extensive searches were conducted by land, air, water and dragging operations for several miles along the river, all with negative results. Cyril was never found and is presumed dead from drowning.

Case reference: 2014002914.CaseDesc: Edward Allan Street was last seen at his rooming house on Columbia St in Kamloops, BC.  At around 8:30 am on March 4, 2000, Edward told his friends that he was quickly dropping by his place of work but would be back in time for a meeting at 10:00 am.  His wallet and ID were left inside his room.

Amputation: Right Ring Finger, Amputated at 1st knuckle
Right Middle Finger, Amputated at 1st knuckle
Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Foot, Broken foot as a child

Case reference: 2014001441.CaseDesc: On April 28, 1972, James Cordell was seen for the last time leaving his parents’ residence in St. Catharines, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, James was driving a 1970 silver blue Dodge Polar vehicle.  He had a cast on his right arm and his teeth were wired shut as a result of a motor vehicle collision.

Shirt: Purple, Lavender, Mauve, White, SHRT SLEEV, Mauve and white terrycloth short sleeve

Case reference: 2010005899.CaseDesc: Mark Edmonson disappeared from his residence in Stoney Creek on October 3, 1999. Mark has not returned or contacted his family members since that time and both his family and Police are concerned for his well being. Mark is developmentally challenged. It is believed that Mark left home without taking any money or personal identification. Extensive police searches have failed to determine his whereabouts.

Pants: Blue, Jeans with hole in left knee

Case reference: 2024018918.CaseDesc: Benjamin Sullivan was last seen on February 3rd, 2024 and reported missing on April 21, 2024 from Moncton, New Brunswick.  Benjamin has not been seen or heard from since July 2023. Benjamin is known to live a transient lifestyle and does not have a fixed address. Extensive searches around the city of Moncton, including verifications at shelters and hospitals have been unsuccessful in locating Benjamin.

Case reference: 2014004910.CaseDesc: Dillirajah Suppiah was last seen in 2002, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014006241.CaseDesc: On September 7, 2013, at around 10 am, Ranjit Singh was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Ranjit had travelled from India to visit Toronto and was due to return home on a flight scheduled for 5 pm, but he never boarded the plane.

Case reference: 2014005838.CaseDesc: Dale Jackson was last seen on June 28, 2010 in Edmonton, Alberta.  Dale left behind all his personal belongings including his cell phone.

Case reference: 2014002769.CaseDesc: On July 5, 1983 Michael Weatherly was last seen leaving a taxi at a local General Store in Willow River, British Columbia. Michael was later reported missing by his sibling as the missing's home was found vacant and boarded up. Michael was known to be sick, could not eat solid foods. Michael had returned items he borrowed from others, a week before he went missing.  Michael has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2012020082.CaseDesc: Katelyn Noble was last seen in the Radisson, SK district in mid August, 2007. Katelyn has had no contact with her family or friends in Mission, BC, and her whereabouts are unknown.

Case reference: 2014003550.CaseDesc: Kenneth James Schmit, who went by "Jimmy", was last seen leaving a social gathering at a home in St. Walburg, Saskatchewan at 10:30 p.m. on September 22, 1966. Kenneth was feeling despondent, and, at the time of his disappearance, he sported a heavy beard. Numerous searches of the area were conducted, however, he was not located.

Case reference: 2025041574.CaseDesc: Michael Starkes has been missing since July 21, 2025 from St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador. Michael's vehicle, a white Kia Soul, was located in the area of Red Head Road in Flatrock, Newfoundland and Labrador. It is believed Michael is to be deceased after going into ocean.

Case reference: 2013000054.CaseDesc: On December 28, 2006, Carlisle Callum-Drummond was seen for the last time in the Cotes-des-Neiges -Notre-Dame-de-Grace district of Montreal, Quebec. Carlisle left from his home and it is possible that he may be with his father, who is also missing.

Case reference: 2014004301.CaseDesc: Zolton Zambory was reported missing by his estranged wife on January 24, 1965. On January 30, 1965, Vancouver City Police located his vehicle abandoned in Vancouver. His vehicle was unlocked with his personal belongings left behind. He emigrated from Germany and arrived in Quebec on May, 1957.

Case reference: 2014002936.CaseDesc: On February 3, 1988, David Ambroise, then 3 years old, was playing near the Saint-Maurice River in the First Nations reserve of Wemotaci, Quebec. David approached too close to the water, slipped and fell in. He was then swept away by the current, and has never been found despite searches.

Case reference: 2014005333.CaseDesc: Jack Nutter attended a medical appointment in Moncton, New Brunswick, in June 2007, later leaving and has not been seen since. Police have not been able to confirm any sightings of Jack since his appointment. Jack's family is concerned for his wellbeing.

Case reference: 2014004992.CaseDesc: On October 12, 2004, at approximately 11:30 a.m., Kim Evans was seen for the last time at the North York Women’s Shelter in Toronto, Ontario. Kim had said she was going to her family’s residence to collect her personal belongings.

Pierce: Nose, Nose ring on the right side

Case reference: 2008003699.CaseDesc: Gary Anderson and his wife Dawn were camping and fishing on Kilburn Lake in Woodland Caribou Provincial Park.  Gary went out fishing on the lake alone in his canoe and never returned. A search by land, water and air turned up only a fishing lure and a hat.

Case reference: 2013000101.CaseDesc: Oswald Bear departed from his parents' residence in Peguis First Nation, Manitoba on October 19, 1969 with the intention of harvesting wood in a nearby forest. Oswald was well-acquainted with the area and enjoyed the task of chopping wood. He had spent a considerable amount of time in the area and was intimately familiar with it. He had never been lost in the bush and had never failed to return home previously. At 6:15 p.m., he visited his sister's residence, which was located nearby. His sister advised him to return home shortly thereafter to alleviate their mother's concern. Oswald left his sister's residence with the intention of returning home, but he was not seen again.

Case reference: 2020011625.CaseDesc: On or around January 15, 1975, John Hovey was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014002912.CaseDesc: On June 29, 1982, Serge Aumont was seen for the last time in the Hochelaga district of Montreal, Quebec. Serge left his mother’s home with a friend to go to a medical clinic. He has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014006470.CaseDesc: On June 4, 2001, Shahzad Ahmed was seen for the last time at his residence in Toronto, Ontario. Shahzad last contacted his mother by telephone to tell her that he had been fired from his job. During the course of their conversation, his mother had told him to return home to her apartment in Toronto, but he never arrived. The next telephone call that Shahzad’s mother received was from the Islamabad police in Pakistan, who had informed her that Shahzad’s luggage had been found unclaimed on the airport luggage carousel.

Case reference: 2008021099.CaseDesc: On September 17, 1966, Diane Prevost was seen for the last time as she was camping at Grundy Provincial Park in Britt, Ontario. Case reference: 2014004253.CaseDesc: On October 13, 2000, two boats set off on the Churchill River, bound for Granville Lake in Manitoba. One of the boats began taking on water and experiencing engine trouble. Most of the occupants of the disabled boat transferred to the other boat. However, William Linklater stayed on the disabled boat, attempting to start it. The missing boat was located the next day; however, William was not aboard. He is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2020011480.CaseDesc: On May 11, 1988, Amerk Barbarian was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Amerk had been seen by his landlord for the last time when his rent was collected.

Case reference: 2024001775.CaseDesc: Brady Storey was reported missing to police by his mother on January 11, 2024 from Fredericton, New Brunswick. Brady was last seen with Leslie Boyd, who was also reported missing around the same time. Last contact with the couple was on November 7, 2023. Brady was involved in high-risk lifestyle at the time of his disappearance.

Tattoo: Left Chest, Text, "Better to die standing than to live on your knees"

Case reference: 2016068715.CaseDesc: On July 21, 2013, the body of an adult male was found floating in the Niagara River across from the Youngstown Marina, NY, USA near the Niagara-On-The-Lake Sailing Club, Ontario, Canada. Anthropological analysis has suggested that he is black, although there are some features which suggest that he may be mixed Black and Caucasian. He is described as obese however this may be due to post-mortem changes. He is thought to have been in the water for at least one year to possibly several years.

Case reference: 2013000077.CaseDesc: On October 10, 1986, Michael Semergian was seen for the last time in the Outremont District in Montreal, Quebec. Michael has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014001837.CaseDesc: On September 29, 1979 at approximately 8:30 a.m. seven men departed from Anama Bay, Manitoba on a fishing trip. The men departed as a group in three separate boats and were heading for Warpath. At approximately 7:30 p.m. that same day, the occupants of the first boat reported to the RCMP that the other two boats were missing. They described the waves as being three to four feet high and they could not see the tree line from where they were. They lost sight of the other two boats and fired shotgun shots into the air hoping for a response. No response was received. Extensive patrols by air, boat and land were made in an attempt to locate the remaining five men. The bodies of Fredrick Ursu and Jerry Hudy were never recovered. They are presumed dead due to drowning.

Case reference: 2014005597.CaseDesc: On October 1, 2010, André Benoit was last seen at his home in Sainte-Marguerite-du-Lac-Masson, Quebec. André may have gone to Montreal, Quebec in the days preceding his disappearance. The attempts to locate André have been negative to this date.

Case reference: 2014004550.CaseDesc: On November 18, 2004, David Creaser was seen for the last time in Edmonton, Alberta.

Tattoo: Shoulders, One side features a tigre, and the other, a dragon

Shaun was known to have substance abuse problems and was diagnosed as a paranoid-schizophrenic.

Case reference: 2016017728.CaseDesc: Reid Chesney left a men's shelter in Halifax, Nova Scotia on April 4, 2016 and  has not been seen or heard from since. Reid lived a transient lifestyle and had very little communication with family members.

Case reference: 2023055243.CaseDesc: Adam Payne was last seen on August 8, 2023, in Kingsville, Ontario.  He was seen getting into a canoe with a red dinghy attached to the back of it and head westbound into Lake Erie.

Case reference: 2012020123.CaseDesc: Paul Côté left his residence on June 13, 2000 and hasn’t been seen since. Paul's car, a black 2000 Chevrolet Blazer, was located a few days later on June 18, 2000, in a commercial parking lot in the city of Rimouski, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014006179.CaseDesc: On July 8, 2013, Burnaby RCMP were advised that Lon Batchelor had sent his brother a letter requesting he become his power of attorney and that he give his daughter a good-bye note (stating that Lon was "going for the long walk"). This is out of character for Lon. Anyone having seen Lon since July 1, 2013, or who may be able to provide any information as to his whereabouts, is asked to contact the police.

Case reference: 2012020099.CaseDesc: Jack (Mike) St. Pierre was last seen on July 17, 2009, at approximately 1:00 p.m. He was on foot southbound from "the point" toward the hamlet of Wollaston Lake, Saskatchewan. Jack may have been seen later taking a boat across the Bay at Wollaston Lake, Saskatchewan. Articles of clothing were located in the water near where he was last thought to have been seen.

Case reference: 2014002239.CaseDesc: On the August 24, 1993, Cynthia-Ann Peddle, commonly known as Cindy Paddle, was seen for the last time in Sept-Îles, Quebec. There is a possibility that Cindy frequented the area of Vieux Quai in Sept-Îles before her disappearance.

Pants: Denim, Blue, Faded Jeans, thigh pockets
Vest: Red, Pink, T-Shirt, Pink or red

Case reference: 2014003250.CaseDesc: On November 1, 1974, four people left the Whitedog Indian Reserve, Ontario in a 14' Lund boat and were heading for Pointe du Bois, Manitoba. Their intention was to go to Pointe du Bois to pick up supplies and then return to Whitedog. On November 5, 1974, these individuals were reported missing as they had never returned to Whitedog.  It is believed that the boat overturned and everyone drowned. Two bodies were recovered, and the cause of death was determined to be drowning. Searches were conducted by boat and by air but the bodies of Paul Scott and Richard Petawanahqueb were never recovered.  Paul and Richard are presumed dead due to drowning. No foul play is suspected.

Case reference: 2018008636.CaseDesc: On February 6, 2018, at approximately 11:30pm, Guerman Pouchkine was last seen in the area of Steels Avenue West and Keele Street in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020021517.CaseDesc: Ashley Collins was last seen on June 16, 2020 in Drayton Valley, Alberta. At the time of her disappearance, Ashley was leading a high risk lifestyle, and is diabetic.

Case reference: 2014005541.CaseDesc: On September 5, 2010, Shawn Smith was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. On September 6, Shawn arrived in the Dominican Republic and was scheduled to return on September 12, but never returned home.

Case reference: 2014004377.CaseDesc: On October 3, 2003, a family member contacted the police to report that Dwayne Ross had been missing since the evening of October 1. They indicated that Dwayne and his cousin had been drinking together that night, and that his cousin had lost sight of him in the bushes on their way home. Dwayne didn't return home. There were sightings following his disappearance, but no one spoke to Dwayne. These sightings are unconfirmed. Further unconfirmed sightings were reported across Canada and also investigated. Dwayne has not yet been found, and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014006252.CaseDesc: On September 12, 2013, Meagan Rose Pilon was seen for the last time at her family home in Sudbury, Ontario. At the time of her disappearance, Meagan was living in the New Sudbury area. Police have not been able to rule out foul play in her disappearance.

Case reference: 2014004860.CaseDesc: Lesley Holmes was reported missing by her common law husband on December 23, 2005 after not having contact with her since November 23, 2005.  They had been living in a basement apartment in Toronto, the home of a friend. Lesley did not feel comfortable staying there without her common law who was away, so she moved out. She was believed to have spent some time in a shelter but this could not be confirmed by the shelter.  Her family has not seen or heard from her since that time.

Case reference: 2014002370.CaseDesc: On June 16, 1997, at approximately 4:30pm, Kelvin Zdarski and two friends left Dauphin, Manitoba and drove to a cabin near Waterhen, Manitoba. During the evening there was an argument between the men. Kelvin left the cabin and never returned. The men looked for him on their way back to Dauphin but did not see him. On June 17, around 7:30am, a man fitting Kelvin's description was seen walking on a local road. An extensive search by land, air and water proved unsuccessful. Kelvin did not take his wallet, money or identification with him and had no means of transportation.

Case reference: 2014001522.CaseDesc: On July 7, 1977, James Stackhouse and a colleague were camped on a small island on the east shore of Lake Winnipeg, north of Hole River in Manitoba. Their vessel was drifting southwards, approaching Deer Island, which is situated 6 kilometres south of their current position. At approximately 6:00 p.m., the two men departed the shore, each holding onto small logs that had been tied together. They attempted to swim to Deer Island, but strong currents and waves carried them instead to a location east of Deer Island. The improvised raft constructed by the men was compromised, leading to their separation. The friend swam to Deer Island, but unfortunately James was not seen again. Extensive searches of the area were conducted using a variety of methods, including land, air, and water, but the body of James was not recovered.

Case reference: 2026010041.CaseDesc: James (Jimmy) Paige was last seen on March 23, 1963 in Brantford, Ontario. It is believed that he perished by drowning in the Grand River. However, the sole witness to the incident was a five-year-old, whose account of events is not considered reliable.

Case reference: 2014004591.CaseDesc: In July 2004, Philip Leishman left his residence with a friend from Kakisa Lake, Northwest Territories. Philip had told his family that he would be travelling to Fort McMurray, Alberta, and it was confirmed that he was in Fort McMurray until late August of 2004. Philip has ties to Port Alberni, British Columbia, Grande Prairie, Alberta, and Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2006005199.CaseDesc: On Friday, July 1, 2005, at approximately 3:00 p.m., Laura Flanagan departed her cottage with the intention of canoeing around Halls Lake in the Algonquin Highlands region of Ontario. Members of the local community reported seeing her alone in the canoe. A search of the lake revealed that her canoe had been washed up on the east side of the lake. Despite an exhaustive search of the lake, Laura remained unlocated.

Case reference: 2014004918.CaseDesc: On  September 15, 1993, three men were travelling up the Burntwood River in Manitoba to Wuskwatim Lake for commercial fishing. The men left Nelson House and, according to the sole survivor, they hit a rock and the engine stalled. The vessel was not equipped with a starter and the men were unable to restart the motor before passing through the rapids.   Despite an intensive search by land, sea and air, the bodies of William and Thomas were never recovered.
